items.headline: Iran's mediation offer goes unanswered; Shabwa camp toll rises to 73 — diplomacy stalls while the escalation thread stays hot
bullets: What happened: Iranian FM Abbas Araqchi said Tuesday that Tehran has received NO response from Saudi Arabia or the Houthis to its offer to broker talks to end the fighting (interview with Iraq's Al Ekhbariya TV, Oct 20, per Reuters). Saree claimed the camp was run by Saudi forces; Saudi authorities didn't immediately respond. Monday's Yanbu/Shaybah/airport claims remain unconfirmed by Riyadh.
Watch: any Saudi or Houthi reply to the mediation offer, the next Houthi launch cycle, and Brent (~$109) — the risk premium holds until a real supply hit or a deal lands.

items.headline: Riyadh missile intercept confirmed; UK sends RAF Typhoons to defend Saudi Arabia — the escalation thread's first Saudi on-record confirmation and the West's first fighter deployment

Follows the March RAF Sky Sabre deployment and joins French forces already defending Yanbu.

Watch: the next Houthi launch / Saudi response cycle, Egypt's troop-vote (delayed to Oct 26), and US–Iran breakthrough headlines. Oil is the real-time scoreboard: Brent near its five-month high (~$109, down slightly on the day) despite the intercept — the premium is priced until a real supply hit lands.
